aggressor_proof.hypothesis: buy = YES-taker (lifts the ask); sell = NO-taker (hits the bid)
aggressor_proof.why_this_bar: 95% consistency on at least 20 resolvable rows. A mis-read aggressor turns non-interaction into TRADE_AT_PRICE and fabricates the very evidence this exercise exists to find.

bounds.label: PMUS_MIRROR_RAW_BOUNDS_V1

bound_definitions.STRICT: TRADE_THROUGH_PRICE only -- queue-INDEPENDENT: a print through our price consumed everything resting at it
bound_definitions.PLAUSIBLE: TRADE_AT_PRICE / TRADE_THROUGH_PRICE / OBSERVABLE_FILL_PLAUSIBLE -- real interaction, but queue-DEPENDENT
bound_definitions.COPYABILITY: every action maker-copyable at receipt, no interaction requirement -- the upper bound

STRICT.residual_note: UNMARKED. Its value is the window's outcome, which is not knowable from the tape, and L5's own residual line is negative.
STRICT.taker_fees_note: every intent is a maker join; nothing crosses
STRICT.net_note: matched settlement plus the rebate ACCRUAL. The residual is excluded because it is unmarked, so this is not a complete P&L.
STRICT.label: SHADOW. No order existed; no fill is claimed.
